about: A free billing and client management app for web hosting businesses.

prs.title: Monthly orders keep the right month
prs.broken: An order started on the 29th to 31st could expire in the wrong month. One placed on 31 January skipped February and then renewed on the 3rd.
prs.changed: Month and year periods now land on the last day of the target month when that month is shorter.
prs.matters: Customers are billed and renewed in the month they expect.
